summary:
The PR adds notification and item-summary helpers.
- Adds a JSON POST helper for item-change notifications.
- Adds formatted aggregation of item prices.
confidenceReasoning:
The PR is not safe to merge until the outstanding detached notification request and out-of-bounds summary iteration are fixed.

The notification helper still completes before its fetch settles, while the summary helper still dereferences one element beyond every supplied array.

**Files Needing Attention:** demo/target-app/src/notify.ts
